newsitem.title: USA: Simon DeBartolo Group opens two megamalls.
newsitem.headline: Simon DeBartolo Group opens two megamalls.

text.p: Simon DeBartolo Group Inc., which opened Southern California's first value-oriented megamall last week, said it opened a second regional mall in Florida in Vero Beach, Fla., the following day.

The Indianapolis-based real estate investment trust said the 1.7-million-square-foot Ontario Mills mall in Ontario, Calif., is the largest shopping center to open in the continental United States this year. The project is a joint venture that includes Mills Corp.

Simon DeBartolo Group said the opening of the Indian River Mall in Vero Beach, the day after the debut of Ontario Mills last Thursday, gives the company 30 malls and community centers in the state of Florida alone.
The mall openings are the first fince the merger of Simon Property Group and DeBartolo Realty Corp in August.
The REIT currently owns or has an interest in a total of 113 million square feet of leasable space in 33 states.
